notes.title: Elemdian Demo Returns September 25!
notes.content: [p][b]Hey everyone,[/b][/p][p][/p][p]I’m happy to tell you the [b]Elemdian demo[/b] will be back on [b]Thursday, September 25[/b].[/p][p]This new version has its own [b]demo island[/b] to explore. A lot of polish and improvements were made to the [b]UI, elemental spells, and the overall feel of the game[/b]. The [b]controls were also reworked[/b] to make battles smoother.[/p][p][/p][p]If you enjoy the demo, please consider [b]wishlisting Elemdian[/b] (it really helps a lot).[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks so much for the support.[/p]
